name: How long does a kitchen cabinet upgrade project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a kitchen cabinet upgrade project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a kitchen cabinet upgrade project depends on its complexity. Refacing existing cabinets can take a few days to a week. A full cabinet replacement, especially if it involves custom cabinetry or reconfiguring the kitchen layout, might take several weeks. We will provide a timeline estimate after understanding your project's specifics during the consultation phase.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration varies by complexity; refacing takes days to a week, full replacement several weeks.
